clips.title: The story
paras: The Treaty of Understanding is an ancient dwarven tablet detailing the historic peace agreement between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer clans following the War of the Three Hammers. Recovered from subterranean depths and brought before King Magni Bronzebeard, the artifact preserves a pivotal moment in dwarven history while highlighting the bitter rift that left the Dark Iron clan excluded from the peace.

Recovered from deep within an ancient vault, the Treaty of Understanding is a historic stone tablet documenting the formal cessation of hostilities between dwarven clans. Dating to the turbulent aftermath of the War of the Three Hammers, it represents the moment peace was forged between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer clans after the Bronzebeards secured control of Ironforge mountain.

When presented with the recovered tablet, King Magni Bronzebeard recognizes it as the work of his ancestor, Madoran Bronzebeard, the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge. While the document bears the signatures of both the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer leaders, it conspicuously lacks the mark of the Dark Iron clan, serving as a lasting testament to the enduring rift between the Dark Irons and their mountain kin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you brought from the depths, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.
As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... And the Dark Irons did not.
Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, adventurer.
